'''Max''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was one of the [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|freedom fighters]] that were led by [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], they were one of the the Twi'leks that were massacred by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] forces during the initial stages of the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]]. After their [[Death/Legends|death]], Max was one of many freedom fighters who were buried in a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] graveyard on [[Ryloth/Legends|their homeworld]]. Max's name was inscribed in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] on the gravestone.
